enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed on the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Close eyes. Keep both arms under the pillow. Turn onto the back. Stretch the right leg out. Pull the blanket over the left shoulder. Turn onto the left side. Place the left hand under the pillow. Bend the knees. Straighten the legs. Turn onto the back again. Move the right arm above the blanket. Push the pillow up with the head. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket down to the chest. Put the right hand on the mattress. Keep breathing steadily with eyes closed. Turn onto the back once more. Lay both arms along the body. Remain lying with eyes closed until the alarm.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and morning hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Reach the right hand to the phone on the bedside table. Press the phone screen to stop the alarm. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Put both feet on the floor. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open with the right hand. Step inside. Press the light switch with the right hand. Turn on the tap with the left hand. Bend forward over the sink. Cup both hands and scoop water. Splash water on the face three times. Straighten up. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush from the cup. Turn on the tap. Hold the toothbrush under the water. Turn off the tap. Squeeze toothpaste from the tube onto the toothbrush. Put the toothpaste tube down on the shelf. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth with water. Rinse the toothbrush under the water. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back in the cup. Pick up the comb. Comb the hair. Put the comb down. Press the light switch to turn it off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making a hot drink with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch. Open the refrigerator door with the right hand. Take out the milk carton. Put the milk carton on the counter. Take out the bread bag. Put it on the counter. Close the refrigerator door. Open the cupboard door. Take out a bowl. Put the bowl on the counter. Close the cupboard door. Open the bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Put the slices onto a plate. Close the bread bag. Pick up a knife from the drawer. Spread butter on the bread. Put the knife down. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the butter. Put it back after use and close the door. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Put the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch to start boiling. Pour milk into a mug. Fill the bowl with cereal. Sit down at the table. Eat the bread and cereal with the spoon. Lift the mug and drink the milk. Stand up. Carry the plate and bowl to the sink. Open the dishwasher door. Load the plate, bowl, spoon and mug into the dishwasher. Close the dishwasher door. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into a cup. Add a tea bag. Stir with a spoon. Pick up the cup. Drink the hot drink. Put the cup down. Wipe the counter with a cloth.

Walk to the hallway. Pick up the bag from the hook. Put the bag on the left shoulder. Pick up the keys from the shelf. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Open the front door with the right hand. Step outside. Close the door behind. Lock the door with the key. Walk down the stairs. Push the building entrance door open. Step out to the street. Walk along the pavement to the bus stop. Stop at the bus stop. Take the phone out. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone back in the pocket. Step forward as the bus arrives. Step onto the bus. Take the travel card out of the bag. Tap the card on the card reader. Put the card back into the bag. Walk along the aisle. Hold the handrail with the right hand. Stand near the door. Step off the bus at the stop. Walk along the pavement to the hospital entrance. Push the entrance door open. Walk to the locker room. Open the locker with the key. Take off the coat. Hang the coat inside the locker. Take out the work uniform from the bag. Put on the uniform top. Put on the work shoes. Close the locker door. Walk to the ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a day shift as a health care professional, providing patient care and updating clinical records
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the nurse station. Pick up the handover sheet from the desk. Read the handover sheet. Sit down at the computer. Log into the computer with the password. Open the patient record system. Type the patient notes on the keyboard. Click the mouse to save the record. Stand up. Walk to patient room 1. Push the door open. Greet the patient. Say good morning to the patient. Pick up the blood pressure cuff from the trolley. Wrap the cuff around the patient's arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the blood pressure value on the screen. Remove the cuff from the arm. Put the cuff back on the trolley. Pick up the thermometer. Place the thermometer under the patient's tongue. Take the thermometer out. Read the temperature value. Put the thermometer into the holder. Pick up the medication cup from the medicine trolley. Hand the cup to the patient. Hand a glass of water to the patient. Take the empty cup back. Write the values on the chart with a pen. Walk to patient room 2. Push the door open. Straighten the pillow under the patient's head. Pull the blanket up to the patient's chest. Press the call button on the bed rail to check it. Walk back to the nurse station. Sit down at the computer. Type the updated notes on the keyboard. Click the mouse to submit. Stand up. Walk to the supply room. Open the cupboard door. Take out two packs of gauze. Take out a box of gloves. Close the cupboard door. Carry the supplies to the ward trolley. Place the gauze on the trolley. Place the gloves on the trolley. Walk to the patient room 3. Wash hands with the hand gel dispenser. Press the pump with the left hand. Rub both hands together. Push the room door open. Check the IV drip bag on the stand. Adjust the flow regulator wheel. Read the monitor display. Write the value down on the chart. Walk back to the nurse station. Sit down at the computer. Type the notes on the keyboard. Answer the phone at the desk. Pick up the handset. Say hello into the handset. Write on the notepad with a pen. Put the handset down. Stand up. Walk to the staff room. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the lunch box. Close the door. Sit down at the table. Open the lunch box. Eat lunch with a fork. Stand up. Put the lunch box into the bag. Walk back to the ward. Repeat the patient rounds. Push the medicine trolley along the corridor. Stop at each room. Push the door open. Hand the medication cup to the patient. Write on the chart. Push the trolley to the next room. Return the trolley to the storage room. Sit down at the computer. Type the end-of-shift notes on the keyboard. Click the mouse to save. Log out of the computer. Stand up. Walk to the locker room. Open the locker. Take off the work shoes. Put on the coat. Take the bag out of the locker. Close the locker door. Walk to the exit.

Walk out of the hospital entrance door. Walk along the pavement to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the bag. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone back into the bag. Step onto the bus as it arrives. Take the travel card out of the bag. Tap the card on the card reader. Put the card back into the bag. Walk along the aisle. Hold the handrail with the right hand. Stand near the door. Step off the bus at the stop. Walk along the pavement to the building entrance. Push the building entrance door open. Walk up the stairs. Stop at the front door. Take the keys out of the bag. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the front door open. Step inside. Close the door behind. Turn the key to lock the door. Put the keys on the shelf. Take off the shoes. Put the shoes on the rack. Hang the bag on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing hands and freshening up after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Press the light switch. Turn on the tap with the right hand. Hold both hands under the water. Press the soap dispenser with the left hand. Rub both palms together. Rub the fingers. Rinse both hands under the water. Turn off the tap. Pull a paper towel from the dispenser. Dry both hands with the paper towel. Throw the paper towel into the bin. Turn on the tap again. Cup water in both hands. Splash water on the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Look into the mirror. Press the light switch to turn it off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, then rinsing dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the chicken pack. Put them on the counter. Close the refrigerator door. Open the cupboard door. Take out a pot. Put the pot on the induction cooker. Close the cupboard door. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Turn the dial to set the heat. Pick up a knife from the drawer. Cut the vegetables on the chopping board. Put the knife down. Open the pot lid. Put the vegetables into the pot. Put the chicken into the pot. Add salt from the container. Stir with a ladle. Put the lid back on the pot. Open the range hood with the button. Pick up the phone from the counter. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone down. Open the pot lid. Stir the food with the ladle. Turn the dial to lower the heat. Pick up a bowl from the cupboard. Fill the bowl with the food using the ladle. Carry the bowl to the table. Sit down on the chair. Eat the food with a spoon. Lift the water glass and drink. Stand up. Carry the bowl and spoon to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the bowl under the water. Turn off the tap. Open the dishwasher door. Load the bowl and spoon into the dishwasher. Load the pot into the dishwasher. Load the ladle into the dishwasher. Add a detergent tablet. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button. Press the power button on the induction cooker to turn it off. Press the range hood button to turn it off. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Press the light switch to turn it off. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Press the light switch. Pick up the remote control from the coffee table. Press the power button on the remote. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Sit down on the sofa. Lean the back against the cushion. Cross the right leg over the left. Put the remote on the sofa armrest. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone on the sofa. Pick up the remote again. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out a bottle of water. Close the refrigerator door. Walk back to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Open the bottle cap. Lift the bottle and drink. Close the bottle cap. Put the bottle on the coffee table. Pick up the remote. Press the channel button. Put the remote on the armrest. Lean back on the sofa. Stretch both arms upward. Put the arms down. Stand up. Walk to the TV. Press the power button on the TV to turn it off. Walk to the light switch. Press it to turn the light off. Walk to the bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review clinical notes and complete continuing education modules
enriched_activities.desc: Walk back into the living room. Press the light switch. Walk to the desk. Pull the chair out with the right hand. Sit down on the chair. Press the power button on the computer tower. Wait for the screen to light up. Put both hands on the keyboard. Type the login password. Move the mouse with the right hand. Click the browser icon. Type the web address on the keyboard. Press the Enter key. Scroll the page with the mouse wheel. Open the clinical notes file. Read the notes on the screen. Type comments into the text box. Click the save button with the mouse. Open the continuing education module page. Click the start button. Read the module text on the screen. Click the next button. Play the module video. Turn the speakers on with the volume knob. Lean back in the chair. Put the elbows on the desk. Lean forward again. Type the answers in the quiz form. Click the submit button. Read the score on the screen. Click the logout button. Press the computer power button to shut it down. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Walk to the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and completing evening hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Push the door open. Press the light switch. Press the water heater switch to check it is on. Open the shower cubicle door. Turn the shower tap to the left with the right hand. Hold the right hand under the water to test the temperature. Turn the tap slightly to adjust the temperature. Step into the cubicle. Close the cubicle door. Stand under the water. Wet the hair. Press the shampoo bottle with the left hand. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over both arms. Rub the soap over the body. Put the soap back on the shelf. Rinse the body under the water. Turn the shower tap to the right to stop the water. Open the cubicle door. Step out. Pick up the towel from the hook. Rub the hair with the towel. Wipe the body with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush from the cup. Squeeze toothpaste onto it. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water from the tap. Rinse the toothbrush. Put the toothbrush back in the cup. Wipe the face with the towel. Press the light switch to turn it off. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, watching TV and reading on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Press the light switch. Walk to the bed. Pull the blanket down with both hands. Sit on the edge of the bed. Stand up again. Walk to the desk. Pick up the TV remote from the desk. Point the remote at the TV. Press the power button. Press the channel button. Put the remote on the bedside table. Walk to the window. Pull the curtain closed. Walk back to the bed. Sit on the edge of the bed. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up to the waist. Reach the right hand to the bedside table. Pick up the phone. Press the phone screen to unlock it. Scroll the phone screen with the right thumb. Read the text on the phone screen. Put the phone down on the chest. Pick the phone up again. Scroll the screen again. Press the remote on the bedside table. Press the volume button to lower the volume. Put the remote down. Turn onto the left side. Keep the phone in the left hand. Scroll the phone screen. Put the phone on the bedside table. Reach the right hand to the lamp switch on the bedside table. Press the lamp switch to turn the light off. Lie on the back. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Close the eyes.

Lie on the bed with eyes closed. Keep the blanket over the body. Turn onto the right side. Place the right hand under the pillow. Pull the blanket with the left hand. Turn onto the back. Straighten both legs. Move the left arm above the blanket. Turn onto the left side. Bend the knees. Put the left hand under the pillow. Turn onto the right side again. Pull the blanket up to the chin. Keep both arms under the blanket. Turn onto the back once more. Lay both arms along the body. Remain lying on the bed with eyes closed.
